args.text: CREATE TABLE A (Label TEXT(10), Hidden TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE AK (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_AK PRIMARY KEY, Label TEXT(10), Hidden TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE B (Label TEXT(10), Tag TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE AM (Label TEXT(10), M MEMO, Bn LONGBINARY)
CREATE TABLE N (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_N PRIMARY KEY, K LONG, T TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE S (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_S PRIMARY KEY, Grp TEXT(10), Piv TEXT(10), Amt LONG, PN LONG, PD DATETIME, Odd TEXT(80))
INSERT INTO S VALUES (6, 'g3', 'c', Null, 3, Null, ' lead')
INSERT INTO S VALUES (7, 'g1', 'b', Null, 2, #2024-01-02#, 'sp ace')
INSERT INTO S VALUES (8, 'g4', Null, Null, Null, Null, Null)
SELECT A.Label, A.Hidden, B.Tag FROM A INNER JOIN B ON A.Label = B.Label;
PARAMETERS pK Long, pT Text ( 10 ); SELECT ID, K, T FROM N WHERE K = pK OR T = pT;
SELECT ID FROM N WHERE K = [Which K];
PARAMETERS pMin Long; TRANSFORM Sum(Amt) AS SA SELECT Grp FROM S WHERE Amt >= pMin GROUP BY Grp PIVOT Piv;
TRANSFORM Sum(Amt) AS SA SELECT Grp FROM S GROUP BY Grp PIVOT Piv IN ('b', 'a', 'zz');
